items.title: Pay invoice for inspection and brake repair
items.quote: Bitte holen Sie es ab und bezahlen Sie die Rechnung bis 07.12.2026.
items.computation: The letter prints two different payment deadlines: "bezahlen Sie die Rechnung bis 07.12.2026" in the body text, and a separate line "Zahlungsziel 10.12.2026" near the bank details. These contradict each other. Both are fixed calendar dates stated by the sender (a private company, not an authority), so no statutory delivery-fiction or §193 BGB weekend/holiday shift applies to a company's own chosen due date; the date is binding as printed. Per the rule to use the earliest plausible date when a letter contradicts itself on a date, 07.12.2026 (the earlier of the two) is taken as the due date, with lowered confidence and a warning about the discrepancy.

warnings: The letter gives two different payment deadlines for the same invoice: "bis 07.12.2026" in the body text and "Zahlungsziel 10.12.2026" near the bank details; the earlier date (07.12.2026) was used as the due date, but the sender should be asked which date actually applies.

The IBAN printed (DE35 3705 0198 0005 5884 40) is well-formed and matches the sender's own bank (Musterbank AG), but a valid IBAN does not prove account ownership; verify the account details against a previous invoice or the garage's official contact information before paying.
